_doc: Industry-wire headline catalog (slice #176, parent #150). Each template is keyed by a structural TRIGGER (what happened in the engine) and carries its own SOURCE (who is talking) and RELIABILITY tier (how much the player should trust it). Reliability is the load-bearing axis: 'direct' already happened and is verifiable on the lot or at the block; 'leading' is a forward call from the analyst desk that fires AHEAD of a shock and may be a false alarm; 'lagging' only confirms a trend the player could already see in their own numbers. Slot placeholders are filled at fire time from live state: {segment} (plural segment label), {pct} (absolute magnitude as a whole percent), {label} (shock catalog label), {brand} (rival brand), {days} (rumor lead time in days). Copy lives here, not in code, so wording retunes without a build. Slice #177 adds trade-press / OEM-bulletin / competitor-watch sources on top of these three.

reliabilityNotes.direct: It already happened — you can verify it.
reliabilityNotes.leading: A call about what's next. It may not pan out.
reliabilityNotes.lagging: Catching up to a trend your own numbers already showed.
